rationale: Employee terminated 2026-06-15; Domain Admin remains active with no revocation ticket.

Box was implemented on 2026-07-21 — inside the Q3 review window — so it is a brand-new application, yet it already holds live entitlements (including the privileged Admin role) that have never been reviewed. A freshly rolled-out app going live with broad, unreviewed access is a classic access-review finding: Box's Q3 entitlements need a first-time review before they are certified.
